record.title: Microduck right ankle bracket — the true x-mirror of microduck-ankle-left: 39.5 x 36.5 x 25.5 mm yellow U-bracket with the 15x10x3 bearing seat, XL330 horn diamond and R16.3 heel hull
record.why: cad/part.py builds the left bracket's measured geometry with HAND=-1 (ankle_right.stl IS ankle_left.stl mirrored about x=0: p95 0.000 mm, max 0.0087 mm — out/measure/ankle/mirror-test.json) and ce-cad/bin/cad-refcheck grades it against reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/ankle_right.stl: p95 0.012 mm both ways, max 0.081 mm, bbox delta [0.001, 0.0, 0.0] mm, 13/13 holes matched (out/refcheck/microduck-ankle-right/r1, re-run with --evidence 2026-09-01T19-04-21Z).
record.origin_why: the x-mirror of part:microduck-ankle-left — one source of measured numbers, two hands. All dimensions were measured off ankle_left.stl (see that part's origin_why); the mirror relation itself was MEASURED, not assumed (mirror-test.json). Admitted through the TRIAD.md door: evidence/ledger.jsonl + computed trust.json.
record.why_this_folder_exists: The right ankle of the Microduck — MJCF body `ankle_right` places mesh ankle_right once (yellow). Its own folder because a mirrored part is its own SKU on the print plate. The older ankle_r_v1.stl variant (39.5 x 46.5 x 25.4, 10 mm wider) is a different part no MJCF body references; it too is a true mirror of ankle_l_v1 (max 0.033 mm).
